Class MySqlLeaderboardRepository

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.repository.MySqlLeaderboardRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
LeaderboardRepository
public class MySqlLeaderboardRepository extends Object implements LeaderboardRepository
MySQL implementation of LeaderboardRepository, backed by a HikariCP connection pool.

On construction, this class reads database connection parameters from a db.properties file on the classpath (see db.properties.example for the required format) and initialises a pool of up to five connections. All queries use PreparedStatement to prevent SQL injection.

The underlying table schema is defined in schema.sql. In particular, a composite index on (num_players, final_score DESC) ensures that getLeaderboard(int) remains efficient even for large result sets.

Call close() when the server shuts down to release all pooled connections.

  • Method Details

    • saveResult

      public void saveResult(GameResult result)
      Inserts one row into the game_results table for the given player result.

      Uses a PreparedStatement with positional placeholders to prevent SQL injection. The LocalDateTime timestamp is converted to a JDBC Timestamp before being bound to the statement.

      Specified by:
      saveResult in interface LeaderboardRepository
      Parameters:
      result - the game result to persist; must not be null
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - wrapping the underlying SQLException if the INSERT fails

    • getLeaderboard

      public List<GameResult> getLeaderboard(int numPlayers)
      Queries the game_results table for all rows matching the given player count, ordered by final_score descending, and maps each row to a GameResult.

      The query leverages the composite index on (num_players, final_score DESC) defined in schema.sql to avoid a full-table scan.

      Specified by:
      getLeaderboard in interface LeaderboardRepository
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the number of players to filter by
      Returns:
      an ordered list of GameResult entries; never null, may be empty
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - wrapping the underlying SQLException if the query fails

    • close

      public void close()
      Closes the HikariCP connection pool, releasing all pooled connections to MySQL. Should be called exactly once when the server shuts down.
